milestones.label: Admission decisions released (Spring 2027 intake, PhD only, Round 1)
milestones.source_text: KAUST's own admission timeline page (official) gives this as the release date for Round 1 decisions. It lists no interview dates; the process page only says shortlisted candidates get an online interview with faculty.

milestones.label: Admission decisions released (Fall 2027 intake, MS, MS/PhD and PhD, Round 2)
milestones.source_text: KAUST's own admission timeline page (official) gives this as the release date for Round 2 decisions. No interview dates are published; shortlisted applicants are invited to an online interview after faculty review.
